name: Plott
heading: Plott is a note-taking app for moving ideas around.
body: I wanted to put two lists next to each other without opening a second note. In Plott, I can start with a plain Markdown outline, grab a few lines, and drag them into columns. When I’m ready to write again, I can pick up right where I left off. The note is still a Markdown file on my Mac.

media.alt: Two quarterly goal lists arranged side by side in Plott’s dark editor.
A screen recording of dragging Markdown list items into a second column in Plott.
